notes: DRAFT from the bible v1.0 section 5. 12 universal variation modifiers with five rarity tiers. A variation modifies a creature; it never creates a new species and never sets threat rank. Overlaps with the existing Variant Modifiers in 08_Bestiary/bestiary_lore.md are recorded in ours.existingModifier. Needs the Canon section 6 OK before any is spawned.
balanceRules: Each variation defines compatible groups, attribute modifiers, new abilities, weaknesses and visual cues.
Tags prevent nonsensical combinations unless a lore reason exists.
Stacking has diminishing returns or a complexity cost; some variations are mutually exclusive.
Awakened is a special state or transformation, not a routine cosmetic modifier.
Ancient indicates age or lineage and does not automatically grant a higher threat rank.
Rarity is not power: a common variation on an SSS monster can still be devastating.

variations.name: Horned
variations.effect: Physical mutation; charging and melee bonuses.

variations.name: Petrified
variations.effect: Stone transformation; high defence, reduced mobility.

variations.name: Corrupted
variations.effect: Dark or unstable energy; unusual powers and corruption effects.

variations.name: Possessed
variations.effect: External entity influences or controls the host.

variations.name: Blessed
variations.effect: Sacred energy; healing, protection and purification.

variations.name: Cursed
variations.effect: Supernatural affliction; debuffs and dangerous effects.

variations.name: Frozen
variations.effect: Ice enhancement; frost attacks and cold resistance.

variations.name: Infernal
variations.effect: Fire enhancement; heat resistance and explosive attacks.

variations.name: Electrified
variations.effect: Electrical energy; speed, lightning attacks and shock effects.

variations.name: Ancient
variations.effect: Ancestral or primordial traits; forgotten abilities.

variations.name: Awakened
variations.effect: Unlocks hidden potential, intelligence or advanced abilities.
